name: Lao Pao
source:
the Web executive.
Their main clients are politicians in the New Territories.
He was in the business of using orphans, children sold by their parents, and people in debt as organ donors, but at Chen's suggestion, he has allowed children around 10-16 years old to enter the Web assasin school where they are trained as assassins.
He manages Yin and Huo Xin.
He has converted a building he owns into a fortress and lives on the top floor, which is called Lao Pao's Fortress Mansion.
